title: Why I started writing
original:
Ideas come and go.

My old ideas, reflecting, sometimes feel stupid… But there is a clear connection between what I thought about a year ago and what I’m envisioning currently. 
So need more better form of recording my idea than just note taking? Note taking is a different medium than writing.
Writing also helps you to recap what you’re thinking right now.

Writing style: Don’t want to take too much time on the writing itself. Not about writing for the sake of writing, more of recording.
Thanks to ChatGPT!
Avant-garde style digital writing, sentence won’t usually make sense… I just skim-write it, very fast, with lots of grammatical errors. But those errors are actually good, the essence is only the idea.
After doing this very vague writing, convert into ChatGPT to add more ‘flesh’ on top of this ‘bone’, and fulfill contents in a universally readable format. Also translate in korean concurrently for other audiences.
english:
Ideas come and go.

Looking back, some of my old ideas seem stupid. Yet I can see a clear connection between what I was thinking a year ago and what I am imagining now. I need a way of recording that connection beyond taking notes. Writing is a different medium: it asks me to revisit and articulate what I am thinking at this moment.

I do not want to spend too much time on writing for its own sake. This is a record of thought. I write quickly, loosely, sometimes in sentences that barely make sense, with plenty of grammatical mistakes. Those mistakes are not necessarily a problem. What matters is the idea.

ChatGPT enters after that first, hurried pass. I use it to put flesh on the bones of these rough notes and make them readable to others. At the time of writing, I also used it to produce Korean versions for another audience. The starting point remains the unpolished thought, not the finished prose.
